The '''Imperial First Mobile Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that saw action during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The fleet was in a state of perpetual readiness, ready to deploy in conflict across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
